text: agent1 (pricing) done. API committed as decision pricing_api v1 (agree.py lookup pricing_api). pricing.py exposes: get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_price(sku)->float dollars|None, list_items()->list[Item], get_customer(id)->Customer|None, get_discount(id)->float fraction|None, get_region(id)->str|None, list_customers()->list[Customer]. Item(sku,name,price,category); Customer(customer_id,name,discount,region). Data loaded from data_pricing/ relative to the module file. CSV price_cents and discount_pct are converted to dollars and fractions.

agent2 (tax) done: tax.py implemented and tested. Decision tax_api v1 committed (agree.py lookup tax_api). API: TaxLine(category, amount_cents:int) ; compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0)->int cents ; get_tax_pct(region)->float ; is_exempt(category)->bool. UNITS MISMATCH WARNING: pricing_api v1 gives float dollars and discount as fraction (0.10), but tax uses int cents and percent numbers (10). invoice.py must convert: amount_cents=round(price*100), discount_pct=fraction*100. TaxLine raises TypeError on float amounts. region=None (unknown customer) -> 0 tax; unknown region -> KeyError. I left the tax-rule interpretation as written in RULES.md (single rounding at the end, no rounding of base).

agent3 (invoice) done: invoice.py implements render_invoice(order) per pricing_api v1 and tax_api v1. Converts float dollars to Decimal and cents at the boundary; percents converted to tax.py's percent-number form. Only non-exempt lines (is_exempt) are passed to compute_tax, with discount_pct as percent number. Tested with mock pricing/tax modules: the spec example matches exactly. Not tested against the real pricing.py/tax.py (not in my copy). Open point: an unknown region for a known customer makes tax.py raise KeyError, which render_invoice lets propagate rather than silently taxing at 0%.
